notes.ARG: 貝爾格拉諾 1812 年設計藍白藍三條；中間有五月太陽的版本 1818 年起是官方的旗，1985 年起成為唯一的國旗。
notes.AUS: 1901 年的設計競賽選出；1908 年聯邦之星改成七個角，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.AUT: 紅白紅 1918 年起，1938–1945 年被德國併吞期間停用，1945 年恢復。
notes.AZE: 1918 年首次採用，蘇聯時期停用，1991 年恢復；2013 年只調整顏色。
notes.BEN: 1959 年首次採用，1975–1990 年改用人民共和國的綠底紅星旗，1990 年恢復。
notes.BGR: 白綠紅三色 1879 年起，共產時期加上國徽，1990 年拿掉。
notes.BLM: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.BLR: 1995 年公投後採用；2012 年只調整左側紋樣的比例。
notes.BMU: 1910 年起；1999 年只把徽章放大。
notes.BOL: 目前的紅黃綠三色 1851 年起（Wikidata 國旗項目的 1825 年是更早的另一面旗）。
notes.BRA: 1889 年採用，星星的數目隨州的數目增加，27 顆星的版本 1992 年起。
notes.COG: 1959 年首次採用，1970–1991 年改用人民共和國的紅旗，1991 年恢復。
notes.COM: 2001 年 12 月的憲法公投通過，2002 年 1 月正式升旗。
notes.CRI: 藍白紅白藍五條 1848 年起；1906 年的修改只改國家機關用的旗上的國徽。
notes.CUB: 1849 年設計，1869 年獨立戰爭的瓜伊馬羅制憲會議採用，1902 年古巴共和國成立後正式使用。
notes.CYM: 1958 年起的藍船旗，1999 年拿掉徽章外面的白色圓盤，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.CYP: 1960 年起；2006 年只改島的顏色。
notes.CZE: 1920 年起是捷克斯洛伐克的國旗，1993 年捷克沿用。
notes.DEU: 黑紅金三色 1919–1933 年用過，1949 年西德再採用，1990 年統一後沿用。
notes.DMA: 1978 年獨立時採用，1981、1988、1990 年各修改過一次圖案細節，現在的版本是 1990 年起。
notes.DNK: 丹麥國旗的圖案至少從 14 世紀就在使用（傳說是 1219 年），1748 年的法令規定了商船旗的樣式（Wikidata）。
notes.ECU: 黃藍紅三色加國徽 1900 年起；2009 年依新規定重新繪製國徽，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.EGY: 1984 年 10 月起（Wikidata 國旗圖檔陳述的 1983 年對不上法令）。
notes.ESH: 撒拉威阿拉伯民主共和國 1976 年宣布成立時採用。
notes.ESP: 紅黃紅三條 1785 年起是海軍旗、1843 年起是國旗；中間的國徽 1981 年改成現在的樣式。
notes.EST: 1918 年首次採用，蘇聯時期禁用，1990 年恢復。
notes.ETH: 綠黃紅三色更早就在使用；中間加藍色圓盤與五角星的版本 1996 年起。
notes.FRA: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.GHA: 1957 年獨立時採用，1964–1966 年中間一條改成白色，1966 年恢復。
notes.GRC: 藍白條紋加十字的版本 1822 年起是海上用的旗，1978 年起成為唯一的國旗（只改了藍色）。
notes.HKG: 1990 年全國人大通過，1997 年 7 月 1 日起使用。
notes.HMD: 1901 年的設計競賽選出；1908 年聯邦之星改成七個角，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.HND: 五顆星的設計 1866 年起；1949、2022、2026 年只改藍色的深淺（2022 年改成青綠色，2026 年改回深藍）。
notes.IND: 1947 年 7 月 22 日制憲會議通過（Wikidata 圖檔陳述的 1946 年有誤）。
notes.IRL: 1922 年愛爾蘭自由邦政府開始使用，1937 年憲法明定為國旗。
notes.ITA: 1946 年共和國成立時拿掉王室的徽章；2006 年只規定顏色。
notes.JPN: 1870 年起是商船旗，1999 年的《國旗國歌法》定為國旗（只微調圓的位置與顏色）。
notes.KGZ: 1992 年採用；2023 年把太陽的 40 道光芒從彎的改成直的，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.KOR: 太極旗 1883 年首次成為朝鮮的國旗，大韓民國 1949 年訂定現在的樣式（之後只調整顏色與比例）。
notes.LAO: 1945–1946 年寮國自由運動用過，1975 年寮人民民主共和國成立時採用。
notes.LBY: 1951–1969 年王國時期的國旗，2011 年恢復。
notes.LCA: 1967 年起；2002 年只改了藍色與三角形的大小。
notes.LIE: 藍紅兩色更早就在使用，1937 年加上王冠（跟海地的國旗區分），1982 年重新繪製王冠，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.LTU: 1918 年首次採用，蘇聯時期禁用，1988 年恢復；2004 年只改比例。
notes.LVA: 1923 年正式採用，蘇聯時期禁用，1990 年恢復。
notes.MAC: 1993 年全國人大通過，1999 年 12 月 20 日起使用。
notes.MAF: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.MEX: 綠白紅三色 1821 年起；中間的國徽 1968 年改成現在的樣式。
notes.MNG: 1992 年起（拿掉共產時期的星）；2011 年只統一顏色與比例。
notes.MWI: 1964 年獨立時採用，2010–2012 年改用白色太陽的版本，2012 年恢復。
notes.NCL: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.NIC: 藍白藍加國徽 1908 年起；國徽 1971 年改成現在的樣式。
notes.NLD: 紅白藍三色從 17 世紀就在使用，1937 年的皇家法令正式規定。
notes.NZL: 1902 年 3 月 24 日起（1901 年的紐西蘭國旗法；Wikidata 國旗項目寫 1903 年）。
notes.PHL: 1898 年首次採用，1907–1919 年被美國殖民政府禁止，1919 年恢復；之後只改過藍色的深淺。
notes.POL: 1919 年起；1980 年的法律只重新規定顏色與比例。
notes.PRI: 1895 年設計，1952 年波多黎各自由邦成立時正式採用。
notes.PRT: 共和國 1911 年 6 月起。
notes.PRY: 紅白藍三色加國徽 1842 年起；2013 年依新法重新繪製兩面的徽章，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.ROU: 藍黃紅三色 1867 年起，共產時期加上國徽，1989 年革命後拿掉。
notes.RUS: 白藍紅三色在帝俄時期就在使用，蘇聯時期停用，1991 年恢復；1993 年只改比例與顏色。
notes.SHN: 聖赫勒拿的旗 1984 年起。
notes.SLV: 1912 年採用，1921–1922 年改用中美洲聯邦的旗，1922 年恢復。
notes.SMR: 白藍兩色加國徽 1862 年起；2011 年的法律重新規定國徽的畫法，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.SOM: 1954 年託管時期採用，1960 年獨立後沿用。
notes.SPM: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.SRB: 紅藍白三色加國徽 2004 年起；2010 年重新繪製國徽，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.SYR: 1932–1958、1961–1963 年用過的獨立時期國旗，2024 年 12 月起過渡政府使用，2025 年 3 月的憲法宣言明定。
notes.TKL: 2009 年起（Wikidata 國旗項目寫 2021 年）。
notes.TKM: 1992 年採用，1997 年加上橄欖枝，現在的版本從此開始；2001 年只改比例。
notes.TLS: 1975 年東帝汶獨立革命陣線宣布獨立時用過，2002 年獨立後採用。
notes.TUN: 1831 年起（Wikidata）；1999 年只規定比例。
notes.TWN: 1928 年 12 月 17 日國民政府明定為中華民國國旗。
notes.USA: 星條旗 1777 年採用，星星的數目隨州的數目增加，50 顆星的版本 1960 年 7 月 4 日起。
notes.VEN: 8 顆星的版本 2006 年 3 月起。
notes.WLF: 三色旗 1794 年採用，1815–1830 年改用波旁王朝的白旗，1830 年起沿用至今；2020 年只把藍色改深。
notes.ZMB: 1964 年獨立時採用；1996 年改了綠色與老鷹的畫法，現在的版本從此開始。
notes.ZWE: 1980 年 4 月 18 日獨立時採用。
notes._IOT: 1901 年的設計競賽選出；1908 年聯邦之星改成七個角，現在的版本從此開始。

notesEn.ARG: Belgrano's blue-white-blue design dates from 1812; the version with the Sun of May has been an official flag since 1818 and the sole national flag since 1985.
notesEn.AUS: Chosen in a 1901 design competition; the current version dates from 1908, when the Commonwealth Star gained its seventh point.
notesEn.AUT: Red-white-red since 1918; not used during the German annexation of 1938–1945 and restored in 1945.
notesEn.AZE: First adopted in 1918, dropped in the Soviet era and restored in 1991; only the shades were adjusted in 2013.
notesEn.BEN: First adopted in 1959; replaced by the People's Republic's green flag with a red star in 1975 and restored in 1990.
notesEn.BGR: White-green-red since 1879; the communist-era emblem was removed in 1990.
notesEn.BLM: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.BLR: Adopted after the 1995 referendum; only the proportions of the ornament were adjusted in 2012.
notesEn.BMU: In use since 1910; the badge was only enlarged in 1999.
notesEn.BOL: The current red-yellow-green tricolour dates from 1851 (the 1825 date on Wikidata's flag item is an earlier, different flag).
notesEn.BRA: Adopted in 1889; stars have been added as states were created, and the 27-star version dates from 1992.
notesEn.COG: First adopted in 1959; replaced by the People's Republic's red flag in 1970 and restored in 1991.
notesEn.COM: Approved in the December 2001 constitutional referendum and first officially raised in January 2002.
notesEn.CRI: The five blue-white-red stripes date from 1848; the 1906 change concerned only the arms on the state flag.
notesEn.CUB: Designed in 1849 and adopted by the independence fighters' Guáimaro Assembly in 1869; official since the Republic of Cuba was founded in 1902.
notesEn.CYM: A Blue Ensign since 1958; the current version dates from 1999, when the white disc behind the arms was removed.
notesEn.CYP: In use since 1960; only the colour of the island was changed in 2006.
notesEn.CZE: The flag of Czechoslovakia from 1920, retained by the Czech Republic in 1993.
notesEn.DEU: Black-red-gold was used in 1919–1933 and readopted by West Germany in 1949, then kept after reunification in 1990.
notesEn.DMA: Adopted at independence in 1978 and modified in 1981, 1988 and 1990; the current version dates from 1990.
notesEn.DNK: The Danish design has been in use since at least the 14th century (legend says 1219); a 1748 ordinance set the merchant flag's form (Wikidata).
notesEn.ECU: Yellow-blue-red with the arms since 1900; the current version dates from 2009, when the arms were redrawn to a new specification.
notesEn.EGY: In use since October 1984 (the 1983 date on Wikidata's image statement does not match the law).
notesEn.ESH: Adopted when the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic was proclaimed in 1976.
notesEn.ESP: Red-yellow-red has been the naval ensign since 1785 and the national flag since 1843; the arms took their current form in 1981.
notesEn.EST: First adopted in 1918, banned in the Soviet era and restored in 1990.
notesEn.ETH: Green-yellow-red is much older; the version with the blue disc and pentagram dates from 1996.
notesEn.FRA: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.GHA: Adopted at independence in 1957; the middle stripe was white in 1964–1966, and the original was restored in 1966.
notesEn.GRC: The striped version with a cross has been the sea flag since 1822 and the sole national flag since 1978 (with a new shade of blue).
notesEn.HKG: Approved by China's National People's Congress in 1990 and in use since 1 July 1997.
notesEn.HMD: Chosen in a 1901 design competition; the current version dates from 1908, when the Commonwealth Star gained its seventh point.
notesEn.HND: The five-star design dates from 1866; only the shade of blue changed in 1949, 2022 and 2026 (turquoise in 2022, back to navy in 2026).
notesEn.IND: Adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 July 1947 (the 1946 date on Wikidata's image statement is wrong).
notesEn.IRL: Used by the government of the Irish Free State from 1922 and enshrined in the 1937 constitution.
notesEn.ITA: The royal arms were removed when the republic was founded in 1946; only the shades were specified in 2006.
notesEn.JPN: The merchant flag from 1870, made the national flag by the 1999 Act on National Flag and Anthem (with minor changes to the disc's position and colour).
notesEn.KGZ: Adopted in 1992; the current version dates from 2023, when the sun's 40 rays were changed from curved to straight.
notesEn.KOR: The Taegukgi was first adopted by Joseon in 1883; the Republic of Korea fixed its current form in 1949 (with later changes to colours and proportions only).
notesEn.LAO: Used by the Lao Issara movement in 1945–1946 and adopted by the Lao People's Democratic Republic in 1975.
notesEn.LBY: The flag of the kingdom in 1951–1969, restored in 2011.
notesEn.LCA: In use since 1967; only the shade of blue and the size of the triangles changed in 2002.
notesEn.LIE: Blue and red are older; the crown was added in 1937 to tell it apart from Haiti's flag, and the current version with a redrawn crown dates from 1982.
notesEn.LTU: First adopted in 1918, banned in the Soviet era and restored in 1988; only the proportions changed in 2004.
notesEn.LVA: Officially adopted in 1923, banned in the Soviet era and restored in 1990.
notesEn.MAC: Approved by China's National People's Congress in 1993 and in use since 20 December 1999.
notesEn.MAF: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.MEX: Green-white-red since 1821; the coat of arms took its current form in 1968.
notesEn.MNG: In use since 1992, when the communist star was removed; only the colours and proportions were standardised in 2011.
notesEn.MWI: Adopted at independence in 1964; replaced by a version with a white sun in 2010–2012 and restored in 2012.
notesEn.NCL: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.NIC: Blue-white-blue with the arms since 1908; the arms took their current form in 1971.
notesEn.NLD: Red-white-blue has been used since the 17th century and was formally established by royal decree in 1937.
notesEn.NZL: In use since 24 March 1902 under the New Zealand Ensign Act 1901 (Wikidata's flag item says 1903).
notesEn.PHL: First adopted in 1898, banned by the American colonial government in 1907–1919 and restored in 1919; only the shade of blue has changed since.
notesEn.POL: In use since 1919; a 1980 law only restated the colours and proportions.
notesEn.PRI: Designed in 1895 and officially adopted when the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico was established in 1952.
notesEn.PRT: The flag of the republic since June 1911.
notesEn.PRY: Red-white-blue with the seals since 1842; the current version dates from 2013, when a new law redrew the seals on both sides.
notesEn.PYF: Adopted after the 1984 statute of autonomy.
notesEn.ROU: Blue-yellow-red since 1867; the communist arms were removed after the 1989 revolution.
notesEn.RUS: White-blue-red was used in imperial Russia, dropped in the Soviet era and restored in 1991; only the proportions and shades changed in 1993.
notesEn.SHN: The flag of Saint Helena has been in use since 1984.
notesEn.SLV: Adopted in 1912; the flag of the Federation of Central America replaced it in 1921–1922, and it was restored in 1922.
notesEn.SMR: White and blue with the arms since 1862; the current version dates from a 2011 law that redefined the arms.
notesEn.SOM: Adopted under trusteeship in 1954 and kept at independence in 1960.
notesEn.SPM: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.SRB: Red-blue-white with the arms since 2004; the current version, with redrawn arms, dates from 2010.
notesEn.SYR: The independence-era flag of 1932–1958 and 1961–1963, used by the transitional authorities since December 2024 and confirmed by the constitutional declaration of March 2025.
notesEn.TKL: In use since 2009 (Wikidata's flag item says 2021).
notesEn.TKM: Adopted in 1992; the current version, with olive branches, dates from 1997; only the proportions changed in 2001.
notesEn.TLS: Used by Fretilin when it declared independence in 1975, and adopted at independence in 2002.
notesEn.TUN: In use since 1831 (Wikidata); a 1999 law only fixed the proportions.
notesEn.TWN: Designated the national flag of the Republic of China by the Nationalist Government on 17 December 1928.
notesEn.USA: Adopted in 1777; stars have been added with each new state, and the 50-star version dates from 4 July 1960.
notesEn.VEN: The eight-star version dates from March 2006.
notesEn.WLF: Adopted in 1794, replaced by the Bourbon white flag in 1815–1830 and in use ever since 1830; only the blue was darkened in 2020.
notesEn.ZMB: Adopted at independence in 1964; the current version, with a new green and a redrawn eagle, dates from 1996.
notesEn._IOT: Chosen in a 1901 design competition; the current version dates from 1908, when the Commonwealth Star gained its seventh point.
